description: Compare processing models (mature chain vs secreted pro-form) against observed apoF apparent mass; attempt PeptideAtlas peptide coverage
code:
import requests, re, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
SEQ=""
avg=dict(G=57.0519,A=71.0788,S=87.0782,P=97.1167,V=99.1326,T=101.1051,C=103.1388,L=113.1594,I=113.1594,
N=114.1038,D=115.0886,Q=128.1307,K=128.1741,E=129.1155,M=131.1926,H=137.1411,F=147.1766,R=156.1875,Y=163.1760,W=186.2132)
m=lambda s: sum(avg[a] for a in s)+18.0153
HEX,HNA,NEU=162.1424,203.1950,291.2579
NGLY=5*HEX+4*HNA+2*NEU           # disialyl biantennary
OGLY=HEX+HNA+NEU                 # sialyl core 1
models={
 'A. mature chain 165-326, no glycan':            (m(SEQ[164:]),0),
 'A+. mature 165-326 + 1 N-glycan + 3 O-glycans': (m(SEQ[164:]),NGLY+3*OGLY),
 'B. pro-form 36-326 (signal only removed)':      (m(SEQ[35:]),0),
 'B+. pro-form 36-326 + 3 N-glycans + 5 O-glycans':(m(SEQ[35:]),3*NGLY+5*OGLY),
 'C. full precursor 1-326':                       (m(SEQ),0)}
rows=[dict(model=k, peptide_Da=round(p), glycan_Da=round(g), total_Da=round(p+g),
           vs_29kDa_HDL=round(p+g-29000), vs_33kDa_LDL=round(p+g-33000)) for k,(p,g) in models.items()]
M=pd.DataFrame(rows); pd.set_option('display.width',200)
print("=== Which processing model matches the observed apparent mass of circulating apoF? ===")
print(M.to_string(index=False))

# --- PeptideAtlas: observed peptides for Q13790 ---
obs=None
for url,params in [
  ("https://db.systemsbiology.net/sbeams/cgi/PeptideAtlas/GetPeptides",
   dict(atlas_build_id=572, protein_name="Q13790", action="QUERY", output_mode="tsv", apply_action="QUERY")),
  ("https://peptideatlas.org/cgi/GetPeptides",
   dict(atlas_build_id=572, protein_name="Q13790", action="QUERY", output_mode="tsv"))]:
    try:
        r=requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=60)
        print("\nPeptideAtlas", url.split('/')[2], r.status_code, "bytes", len(r.text))
        if r.status_code==200 and "\t" in r.text and len(r.text)>200:
            obs=r.text; break
    except Exception as e: print("PeptideAtlas error:", e)
if obs:
    lines=[l for l in obs.strip().split("\n") if l.strip()]
    hdr=lines[0].split("\t"); print("columns:", hdr[:12])
    df=pd.DataFrame([l.split("\t") for l in lines[1:]], columns=hdr)
    print(df.head(40).to_string(index=False)[:3000])
else:
    print("PeptideAtlas could not be queried programmatically from this environment; no peptide-level coverage retrieved.")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,4.2))
lab=list(models.keys()); pep=[models[k][0]/1000 for k in lab]; gl=[models[k][1]/1000 for k in lab]
y=np.arange(len(lab))
ax.barh(y,pep,color='#2a6f97',label='polypeptide')
ax.barh(y,gl,left=pep,color='#e09f3e',label='modelled glycan')
ax.axvline(29,color='#c1121f',ls='--',lw=1.6); ax.text(29.1,-0.65,'29 kDa on HDL\n(PMID 8093033)',color='#c1121f',fontsize=8)
ax.axvline(33,color='#780000',ls='--',lw=1.6); ax.text(33.1,len(lab)-0.6,'33 kDa on LDL\n(PMID 9880564)',color='#780000',fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels(lab,fontsize=8); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.set_xlabel("mass (kDa)"); ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc='lower right')
ax.set_title("APOF processing models against observed apparent mass of circulating apoF")
ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
M.to_csv('apof_mass_models.csv',index=False)
